title: 第1849章 归墟碑前悟真意混洞中期镇八荒第1848章 归墟深处炼神珠混洞中期终突破
content_zh:
林玄站在黑色石碑前，感受着体内的变化。
他的混洞比之前扩大了一倍。
漩涡中心那株道衍之力的幼苗，已经长成了一株半尺高的小树。通体呈白色，树干上布满了细密的纹路，那些纹路在不断流转，散发着玄妙的气息。
小树的顶端长出了三片嫩叶，每一片嫩叶上，都刻着一个古老的符文。
三枚符文不断闪烁，散发着不同的气息。
第一个符文，散发着吞噬的气息，那是混洞之力的本源。
第二个符文，散发着创造的气息，那是道衍之力的雏形。
第三个符文，散发着混沌的气息，那是混沌青莲留下的印记。
林玄看着那三片嫩叶，目光淡定。
他明白，这三片嫩叶，代表了他现在掌握的三种力量——吞噬、创造、混沌。
三种力量在他体内交织，形成一股更加恐怖的力量。
他抬手，一股灰色的力量在他掌心浮现，比之前更加凝实，更加深邃。其中隐约能看到无数星辰在生灭，仿佛蕴含了一个宇宙。
他轻轻一握，那股力量在他掌心消失。
他睁开眼睛，目光中闪过一丝灰色的光芒。
他转身，看向大殿外。
目光穿过大殿，穿过归墟秘境，穿过混沌乱流，落在了混沌大世界的星空中。
他能看到混沌大世界中，那些星辰在运转，那些生灵在活动，那些势力在争斗。
他沉默了片刻，然后缓缓开口：“三个月，还剩两个月零十天。”
他迈步，朝大殿外走去。
走出大殿，走过通道，走出宫殿，走在归墟秘境的灰色雾气中。

那些灰色雾气在他身边流动，被他体内的混洞，缓缓吞噬。
他能感觉到，归墟秘境中的力量，已经无法满足他的需求了，他需要更加强大的力量，才能继续提升。
他走出归墟秘境，穿过混沌乱流，回到混沌大世界的星空中。
他站在星空中，回头看了一眼那片混沌乱流。
它们依然在翻滚，依然在咆哮，但在他眼中已不再危险，他甚至可以，直接吞噬整片混沌乱流。
但他没有这么做。
他知道，这片混沌乱流是混沌大世界的一部分。如果吞噬了它，可能会对混沌大世界造成影响。
他转身，看向混沌大世界的深处，目光穿过无数星辰，落在一颗巨大的星辰上。
它通体呈金色，散发着璀璨的金色光芒，名叫天金皇星。
是天地榜排名第七的强者——天金皇的领地。
他沉默了片刻，然后迈步，朝天金皇星走去。
他的速度快到极致，在星空中划过，留下一道灰色的尾迹。
他飞过的地方，那些星辰都在微微颤动，仿佛它们感受到了林玄体内那股恐怖的力量，在恐惧，在颤抖。
三天后，他来到了天金皇星。
天金皇星，比金阳星大了十倍不止。
整颗星辰通体呈金色，散发着璀璨的金色光芒，星辰表面覆盖着浓郁的金色灵气，不断翻滚，形成一片片金色的云海。
林玄站在天金皇星外，看着那颗巨大的金色星辰，目光平静。
他能感觉到，天金皇星中隐藏着一股强大的气息——是混洞境前期，虽然只是混洞境前期，但比一般的混洞境前期，要强大不少。
他沉默了片刻，然后迈步，朝天金皇星飞去。
他刚进入天金皇星的灵气层，一道金色的光芒就从天金皇星中射出，落在他面前，化作一道金色的光桥。
content_en:
Lin Xuan stood in front of the black stone tablet, feeling the changes in his body.
His hole was twice as big as before.
The sapling of Dao Yan's power in the center of the whirlpool has grown into a small tree half a foot tall. The whole body is white, and the trunk is covered with fine lines. Those lines are constantly flowing, exuding a mysterious atmosphere.
Three young leaves grew from the top of the small tree, and an ancient rune was engraved on each young leaf.
The three runes flashed continuously, exuding different auras.
The first rune exudes the aura of devouring, which is the origin of the power of the hole.
The second rune exudes the aura of creation, which is the prototype of the power of Dao Yan.
The third rune exudes the aura of chaos, which is the mark left by the Chaos Qinglian.
Lin Xuan looked at the three young leaves with calm eyes.
He understood that these three young leaves represented the three powers he now mastered - Devouring, Creation, and Chaos.
The three forces intertwined within his body, forming an even more terrifying force.
He raised his hand, and a gray power emerged in his palm, more solid and deeper than before. Countless stars can be vaguely seen emerging and dying in it, as if it contains a universe.
He squeezed it gently, and the power disappeared in his palm.
He opened his eyes, a gray light flashing in his eyes.
He turned around and looked outside the hall.
His eyes passed through the main hall, through the secret realm of Guixu, through the chaotic turbulence, and landed in the starry sky of the chaotic world.
He could see the stars moving, the creatures moving, and the forces fighting in the chaotic world.
He was silent for a moment, then slowly said: "Three months, two months and ten days left."
He took steps towards the outside of the hall.
Walking out of the main hall, walking through the passage, walking out of the palace, walking in the gray mist of the Guixu secret realm.
The gray mist flowed around him and was slowly swallowed by the hole in his body.
He could feel that the power in the Guixu Secret Realm could no longer meet his needs. He needed more powerful power to continue to improve.
He walked out of the Guixu Secret Realm, passed through the chaos and chaos, and returned to the starry sky of the Chaos World.
He stood in the starry sky and looked back at the chaotic flow.
They were still rolling and roaring, but in his eyes they were no longer dangerous. He could even swallow the entire chaotic flow directly.
But he didn't do that.
He knew that this chaotic flow was part of the chaotic world. If it is swallowed, it may have an impact on the chaotic world.
He turned around and looked into the depths of the chaotic world. His eyes passed through countless stars and landed on a huge star.
It is golden in color and exudes bright golden light. It is called Tianjin Emperor Star.
It is the territory of the Heavenly Golden Emperor, the seventh most powerful person on the Heaven and Earth Ranking.
He was silent for a moment, then took steps toward the Golden Emperor Star.
His speed was extremely fast, streaking across the starry sky, leaving a gray trail.
Where he flew over, the stars were trembling slightly, as if they felt the terrifying power in Lin Xuan's body, trembling with fear.
Three days later, he arrived at the Tianjin Emperor Star.
The Tianjin Emperor Star is more than ten times larger than the Jinyang Star.
The entire star is golden, exuding bright golden light. The surface of the star is covered with rich golden aura, constantly rolling, forming a sea of ​​golden clouds.
Lin Xuan stood outside the Tianjin Emperor Star, looking at the huge golden star with calm eyes.
He could feel that there was a powerful aura hidden in the Tianjin Emperor Star - it was the early stage of the Hundong Realm. Although it was only the early stage of the Hundong Realm, it was much more powerful than the ordinary early stage of the Hundong Realm.
He was silent for a moment, then took steps and flew towards the Golden Emperor Star in the sky.
As soon as he entered the aura layer of Tianjin Emperor Star, a golden light shot out from Tianjin Emperor Star, fell in front of him and turned into a golden light bridge.
